placement.selectionRule: Scene-specific explicit illustration only; never force image for each event. When speaking/acting character is narrative focus, choose matching character or action CG over generic location background. If no confidently matching image, omit.

responsive.upscale: never; rendered dimensions must not exceed intrinsic pixel dimensions

qualityGuidelines.artDirection: simple or diffuse lighting; simplified uncluttered backgrounds; clean cel shading; readable silhouettes
qualityGuidelines.highResolutionAssets: replace small source with truly higher-resolution artwork when needed, do not interpolate to fake detail
qualityGuidelines.compression: WebP quality 75-85; verify by eye; record real byte size
